assets.title: Graves disease — the antibody that mimics TSH
assets.must_show: Normal HPT axis beside the Graves axis, showing TRAb binding the TSH receptor with the negative feedback loop visibly broken, plus the orbital and pretibial fibroblast targets
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Explains why TSH is undetectable while the gland over-produces, and why only Graves causes eye and shin signs
assets.labels: TRH · TSH · TRAb · T3/T4 · feedback cannot reach the antibody · orbital fibroblasts · pretibial fibroblasts

assets.title: Graves vs toxic nodular goitre vs thyroiditis
assets.must_show: Three-column comparison across gland, TRAb, uptake scan, eye/skin signs, patient type, natural course and whether an antithyroid drug works
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Stops carbimazole being prescribed for thyroiditis, where there is nothing to block
assets.labels: diffuse · nodular · tender · TRAb · HIGH diffuse uptake · focal hot nodule · LOW or ABSENT uptake
assets.note: The uptake row is the discriminator and must be visually emphasised — it points the OPPOSITE way in thyroiditis
assets.serves_entry_title: Graves Disease and the Causes of Thyrotoxicosis

assets.title: Antithyroid drug mechanism — and the extra step PTU blocks
assets.must_show: Iodide trapping, thyroid peroxidase, colloid store, release, and peripheral deiodinase — with block ① at peroxidase for all thionamides and block ② at deiodinase for PTU alone
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Explains the 2–6 week delay (stored colloid is untouched) so a beta-blocker is added, and why PTU is the thyroid storm drug
assets.labels: iodide · thyroid peroxidase · colloid store · T4 · deiodinase · T3 · carbimazole · methimazole · PTU
assets.note: The colloid store must be drawn as explicitly untouched by either drug — that is the whole explanation for the delay
assets.serves_entry_title: Antithyroid Drugs — Mechanism, and the Agranulocytosis Rule That Saves Lives

assets.title: Agranulocytosis on antithyroid drugs — warning and action flowchart
assets.must_show: Three symptom icons (sore throat, fever, mouth ulcers), the verbatim patient instruction, and the four-step flow: suspected → STOP the drug → urgent FBC → refer, do not switch thionamide
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: This is the single highest-value instruction in prescribing thionamides. Routine counts miss it; the patient instruction is the safety net
assets.labels: sore throat · fever · mouth ulcers · STOP · urgent FBC · neutropenic sepsis · do NOT switch · drug allergy
assets.note: Must be printable as a patient handout. The instruction is quoted verbatim because paraphrasing it weakens it
assets.serves_entry_title: Antithyroid Drugs — Mechanism, and the Agranulocytosis Rule That Saves Lives

assets.title: Charcot triad and Reynolds pentad
assets.must_show: Three labelled icons — fever with rigors, jaundice, RUQ pain — then the pentad adding shock and altered mental status, then the action point that antibiotics alone do not treat cholangitis
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Moves from antibiotics to source control — the obstruction must be drained, and the pentad makes it same-day
assets.labels: fever/rigors · jaundice · RUQ pain · + shock · + altered mental status · DRAIN the obstruction
assets.note: Must state that not all three are present in every case — waiting for the full triad delays drainage
assets.serves_entry_title: Gallstone Disease — Biliary Colic, Cholecystitis, Cholangitis

assets.title: McDonald criteria — dissemination in space and time
assets.must_show: The entry gate (a typical clinical syndrome, no better explanation), the four locations for space, the four routes to time, and how one scan showing an enhancing plus a non-enhancing lesion proves two different times
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Shows what actually has to be demonstrated, and puts the "no better explanation" gate first where it belongs
assets.labels: periventricular · juxtacortical · infratentorial · spinal cord · enhancing + non-enhancing · oligoclonal bands
assets.note: Deliberately shows the PRINCIPLE, not version-specific lesion counts — those change between revisions and must be read from the version in local use
assets.serves_entry_title: McDonald Criteria — Diagnosing Multiple Sclerosis by Dissemination in Space and Time

assets.title: MS vs NMOSD vs ADEM
assets.must_show: Nine-row comparison including antibody, cord lesion length, encephalopathy and lesion ages, ending in the instruction to send aquaporin-4 before any disease-modifying therapy
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Prevents an MS drug being started in NMOSD, where interferon beta, natalizumab and fingolimod cause harm
assets.labels: AQP4 IgG · longitudinally extensive ≥3 segments · encephalopathy · lesions all the same age · area postrema
assets.note: The cord-length and encephalopathy rows carry the diagnostic weight and are emphasised
assets.serves_entry_title: McDonald Criteria — Diagnosing Multiple Sclerosis by Dissemination in Space and Time

assets.title: Summary — Graves, PTU toxicity, Charcot triad, multiple sclerosis
assets.must_show: Four columns, each with key features, diagnosis, treatment and a red flag row
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: One screen for revision and handover; each column ends with the thing most likely to be missed
assets.labels: key features · diagnosis · treatment · red flags
assets.note: Cross-topic summary — it is a revision aid, not a decision tool. Each red flag is actionable on its own

assets.title: Graves ophthalmopathy — exophthalmos
assets.must_show: Frontal and lateral (worm’s-eye) views of true proptosis, with sclera visible below the lower limbus. The lateral view is essential — proptosis is missed from the front
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Distinguishes true proptosis from lid retraction, which occurs in any thyrotoxicosis and does not mean Graves
assets.labels: proptosis · sclera below the limbus · lid retraction (contrast) · periorbital oedema · conjunctival injection
assets.note: REAL, licence-cleared, de-identified clinical photograph only. Consent for publication required. Must include a lid-retraction-only comparator so the two are distinguishable. Range of skin tones required.
assets.serves_entry_title: Graves Disease and the Causes of Thyrotoxicosis

assets.title: Diffuse goitre of Graves disease
assets.must_show: Neck in neutral position and on swallowing, showing a smooth diffuse enlargement that moves with deglutition — beside a nodular goitre for contrast
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Diffuse versus nodular is the bedside finding that separates Graves from a toxic nodular goitre before any test returns
assets.labels: diffuse smooth enlargement · moves on swallowing · contrast: nodular goitre
assets.note: REAL, licence-cleared, de-identified photograph. Paired diffuse/nodular set is the point of the asset. Range of skin tones required.
assets.serves_entry_title: Graves Disease and the Causes of Thyrotoxicosis

assets.title: Thyroid dermopathy — pretibial myxoedema
assets.must_show: Raised, waxy, orange-peel (peau d’orange) plaques over the shins, with oblique lighting so the texture is visible rather than flat colour
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: A near-specific sign of Graves that is routinely mistaken for chronic venous change or cellulitis
assets.labels: pretibial distribution · non-pitting · peau d’orange texture · well-demarcated plaques
assets.note: REAL, licence-cleared, de-identified photograph. Texture depends on raking light — flat clinical lighting makes this asset useless. Range of skin tones REQUIRED: erythema is the least reliable cue on darker skin and texture must carry the diagnosis.
assets.serves_entry_title: Graves Disease and the Causes of Thyrotoxicosis

assets.title: Antithyroid medications as dispensed
assets.must_show: Carbimazole, methimazole, propylthiouracil and propranolol in the packaging and strengths actually dispensed locally, laid out with names clearly legible
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Helps a patient identify which tablet to stop when told to stop the antithyroid drug — the instruction fails if they cannot tell which box it is
assets.labels: carbimazole · methimazole · propylthiouracil · propranolol
assets.note: REAL photograph of locally dispensed product. NO DOSES are stated anywhere in Scout — the photograph shows identification only. Packaging differs by country, so this asset must be sourced per deployment region, not once globally. No brand endorsement.
assets.serves_entry_title: Antithyroid Drugs — Mechanism, and the Agranulocytosis Rule That Saves Lives

assets.title: Jaundice in acute cholangitis
assets.must_show: Scleral icterus in good natural light, plus skin in a range of tones, since jaundice is far harder to detect on darker skin and the sclera and palate become the reliable sites
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Jaundice is one third of the Charcot triad and is routinely missed under artificial ward lighting and on darker skin
assets.labels: scleral icterus · sublingual and palatal yellowing · natural light required
assets.note: REAL, licence-cleared, de-identified photograph. Range of skin tones is MANDATORY for this asset — a jaundice reference showing only light skin is clinically misleading in the deployment population.
assets.serves_entry_title: Gallstone Disease — Biliary Colic, Cholecystitis, Cholangitis

assets.title: MRI brain — periventricular lesions and Dawson fingers
assets.must_show: Sagittal FLAIR showing ovoid lesions perpendicular to the callosal surface (Dawson fingers), with an axial FLAIR for correlation
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: The perpendicular orientation is what separates MS from age-related or vascular white matter change, which is the commonest cause of MS misdiagnosis
assets.labels: sagittal FLAIR · Dawson fingers · perpendicular to the ventricle · callosocaudate interface
assets.note: HARD RULE: real, licence-cleared, de-identified DICOM only. No AI-generated radiological image ships in Awibi Scout. Ever. MedPix and Radiopaedia are NOT usable — MedPix is personal/local-teaching only and Radiopaedia is CC BY-NC-SA. Source must be an institutional teaching set with written permission, or a permissively licensed research dataset. Full de-identification including burned-in pixel text.
assets.serves_entry_title: McDonald Criteria — Diagnosing Multiple Sclerosis by Dissemination in Space and Time

assets.title: MRI brain — juxtacortical and cortical lesions
assets.must_show: Axial FLAIR or DIR showing a lesion abutting the cortex with no intervening white matter
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: One of the four locations for dissemination in space, and the one most often over-called on standard FLAIR
assets.labels: juxtacortical · U-fibre involvement · DIR sequence improves detection
assets.note: HARD RULE: real, licence-cleared, de-identified DICOM only. No AI-generated radiological image ships in Awibi Scout. Ever. See V-NEUR-R01 for sourcing constraints.
assets.serves_entry_title: McDonald Criteria — Diagnosing Multiple Sclerosis by Dissemination in Space and Time

assets.title: MRI brain — infratentorial lesions
assets.must_show: Axial FLAIR/T2 through the pons and middle cerebellar peduncles showing a discrete lesion
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Completes the four locations; a brainstem lesion also explains internuclear ophthalmoplegia when found clinically
assets.labels: pons · middle cerebellar peduncle · medial longitudinal fasciculus (INO correlate)
assets.note: HARD RULE: real, licence-cleared, de-identified DICOM only. No AI-generated radiological image ships in Awibi Scout. Ever. See V-NEUR-R01 for sourcing constraints.
assets.serves_entry_title: McDonald Criteria — Diagnosing Multiple Sclerosis by Dissemination in Space and Time

assets.title: MRI spine — short-segment MS cord lesion
assets.must_show: Sagittal STIR/T2 showing a lesion under two vertebral segments, with an axial view showing it is eccentric/peripheral within the cord
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: Short and eccentric is the MS pattern. The axial view is what proves eccentricity and is routinely omitted
assets.labels: sagittal STIR · < 2 vertebral segments · axial: eccentric, peripheral, dorsolateral
assets.note: HARD RULE: real, licence-cleared, de-identified DICOM only. No AI-generated radiological image ships in Awibi Scout. Ever. Must be paired with V-NEUR-R05 — the contrast between them is the clinical teaching point.
assets.serves_entry_title: McDonald Criteria — Diagnosing Multiple Sclerosis by Dissemination in Space and Time

assets.title: MRI spine — longitudinally extensive transverse myelitis (NMOSD)
assets.must_show: Sagittal STIR/T2 showing a lesion spanning three or more vertebral segments, with an axial view showing central cord involvement — displayed beside V-NEUR-R04 for direct contrast
assets.changes_what_a_clinician_does: This finding points AWAY from MS and toward NMOSD, where interferon beta, natalizumab and fingolimod cause harm. It changes the drug
assets.labels: ≥ 3 vertebral segments · central cord (contrast: eccentric in MS) · send aquaporin-4 antibody
assets.note: HARD RULE: real, licence-cleared, de-identified DICOM only. No AI-generated radiological image ships in Awibi Scout. Ever. Highest clinical value of the radiology set in this group, because it is the one that changes treatment.
assets.serves_entry_title: McDonald Criteria — Diagnosing Multiple Sclerosis by Dissemination in Space and Time
